definition.name: Actual packaged direct Linux and explicit SSH schedule

steps.name: Download only selected Linux, Rust and native candidates
steps.run:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, os, re, subprocess
support = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'packaged-support'
selected = json.loads((support / 'selection.json').read_bytes())
sha = selected['sourceCommit']
assert re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{40}', sha)
target = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'packaged-candidates'
target.mkdir()
selected['artifacts'] = {}
for name, kind, artifact in (
    ('linux', 'developer', 'developer-linux-candidate-' + sha),
    ('rust', 'developer', 'developer-rust-tools-candidate-' + sha),
    ('native', 'runtime', 'native-runtime-candidate-development-test-' + sha)):
    destination = target / name
    subprocess.run(['gh', 'run', 'download', str(selected['candidateRuns'][kind]['id']),
        '--repo', 'KirilsTurkins/latent-service-fabric', '--name', artifact, '--dir', str(destination)],
        check=True, timeout=300)
    selected['artifacts'][name] = str(destination)
(support / 'gh-linux').chmod(0o700)
selected['trust'] = {
    'developerPolicy': str(support / 'developer-policy.json'),
    'runtimePolicy': str(support / 'runtime-policy.json'),
    'trustedRoot': str(support / 'trusted_root.jsonl'),
    'trustedRootSha256': selected['verificationInputs']['trustedRootSha256'],
    'hostVerifier': str(support / 'gh-linux'), 'guestVerifier': str(support / 'gh-linux'),
    'hostVerifierSha256': selected['verificationInputs']['verifierSha256']['linux'],
    'guestVerifierSha256': selected['verificationInputs']['verifierSha256']['linux']}
(support / 'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(selected), encoding='utf-8')
PY
